concept_definition.meaning: Create a share for a selected colleague; only the uploader may do so.
The uploader revokes a selected share; preparation already started keeps its per-task entitlement.
The uploader and a current named recipient may see the file.
A permitted user queues preparation of a file for later collection.
The background worker starts this task only if the requester is still allowed to access the file at this boundary.
Finish the preparation already started; revocation after its start does not remove this task's entitlement.
The requester may collect this task's ready result even if its original share has since been revoked.
